# Daily Dashboard V0.4.4

## Clock refinements

- Clock agenda items now open a contained event-detail view with the time range, location, calendar, organiser, attendees, and description when available.
- The analog/digital face can be selected directly in the widget and the choice is saved.
- Today's events remain on the right for half-height, two-column, and three-column layouts; the one-column full-height layout reserves the available width for the clock face.
- The agenda scrolls independently when its events do not fit.
- The timezone picker is now a scrollable in-app menu, preventing the native Windows picker from opening beyond the application window.
- Digital numerals are larger and more widely spaced, seconds always have two digits, and the date is centred beneath the full readout.
- The minimalist analog face has no outer outline, labels all twelve hours, and uses a substantially larger date caption.

## Rollback behaviour

Rollback moves to the previous numeric release. From V0.4.4 it offers V0.4.3.

## Verification

- Production frontend build and static/recurrence/map/layout checks
- Rust updater unit tests
- Clock interaction and geometry tests for all four widget sizes at 1280x400 (75% and 100%) and 1920x720 (100%, 150%, and 200%)
